about: Pins for bench:ink. The DiDi data (Google, CC BY 4.0, see docs/THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md) is not committed. download.mjs fetches the fresh-sealed slice (bytes 1000000000-1222429135 of diagrams_20200131.ndjson, sealed 2026-10-10, see tools/bench/ink-fresh-sealed.txt), keeps the complete lines whose split is test (530 drawings), fetches their 501 prompt xdot files, and verifies every sha256 below, failing loudly on a mismatch.

testDrawings.note: test-split lines of the slice after dropping the partial first line, joined with LF plus a trailing LF

prompts.note: per distinct label_id (501 across the 530 drawings): sha256 of xdot/<label_id>.xdot and the PNG [width,height] read from png/<label_id>.png's IHDR

labeller.note: hash of the file with CR bytes removed (the tree may be CRLF)

strokes.note: ink-didi-label.mjs output over the test drawings, as written
